title: Golden Horde: a steppe center
hook: Was the Golden Horde simply a moving army?

frames.heading: Western conquests
frames.text: Batu’s forces conquer the western steppe.

frames.heading: A center
frames.text: Sarai develops on the lower Volga.

frames.heading: Successor states
frames.text: The Horde fragments into smaller states.

reveal: Sarai anchors a history often pictured only as cavalry in motion. The Golden Horde developed an administrative center on the lower Volga. Later succession conflict and fragmentation changed that political network. A conquest map alone cannot show how authority was organized or lost.
limit: Regional reference points, not exact city sites or successor-state borders.

sources.section: Golden Horde: Batu, Sarai, 1359 conflict and fifteenth-century fragmentation
